commands:
cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
FP=$(python3 .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py)
cat > /tmp/flight-input.json <<EOF
{"command": "lib/test/run-shard.sh monolith", "checkout": $FP, "declared_by": "ac-evidence-verifier-1770"}
EOF
CLAIM=$(python3 .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/verification-flight.py claim --input-file /tmp/flight-input.json --state-dir .prflow/tmp/verification-flights 2>&1)
echo "$CLAIM"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp && python3 .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py > /tmp/fp.json && python3 -c "
import json
fp = json.load(open('/tmp/fp.json'))
data = {'command': 'lib/test/run-shard.sh monolith', 'checkout': fp, 'declared_by': 'ac-evidence-verifier-1770'}
json.dump(data, open('/tmp/flight-input.json','w'))
"
cat /tmp/flight-input.json

ls .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1778/deferrals.json 2>/dev/null && cat .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1778/deferrals.json 2>/dev/null; echo "---WORKPAD POST-MERGE---"; WID=$(scripts/workpad.py id 1770 2>/dev/null||true); echo "wid=$WID"; scripts/workpad.py body "$WID" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '\(post-merge\)' | head

PN=$(gh pr view --json number --jq '.number' 2>/dev/null); echo "PR=$PN"; test -n "$PN" && gh api --method PATCH "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/1778" -F body=@/home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/pr-1778-body.md --jq '.number'

git ls-files -z > .prflow/tmp/tracked-1770.z 2>/dev/null; python3 lib/test/pin-corpus-classifier.py --repo-root . --adjudications lib/test/pin-corpus-adjudications.tsv --tracked-files .prflow/tmp/tracked-1770.z --output .prflow/tmp/census-out-1770.tsv --expected-out-of-scope 0 2>&1 | head -30; echo "RC=$?"

sed -n '6455,6470p' /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/parallel-suite/run-493018-0/logs/*monolith* 2>/dev/null; echo "=== gate source ==="; grep -n "mutation-routing worktree gate is established and clean" lib/test/run.sh

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
